q2_task_information_decomposition.obs: Perceive the spoken command from AUDIO only (SlurpRecord carries no sentence field at runtime); recover scenario/action/entity-bearing spans without a reference transcript.
q2_task_information_decomposition.org: Multi-dimensional key retrieval (content/speaker/label/prior) over the TRAIN-modeled knowledge base; a ranking policy fuses dimensions -- Q-K-V doctrine, owner ruling 2026-08-23 section 1.
q2_task_information_decomposition.supply: Consume retrieved TRAIN-derived value cards (scenario/action exemplars, entity-type fillers) as priors, sample-linked, never embedded as ground truth.
q2_task_information_decomposition.use: The frozen core commits to one scenario_action intent and a set of (type, filler) entity slots per utterance.

dev-ladder-dev100.selection_rule_note: Scenario-stratified over the 18 devel scenarios, as evenly as the eligible pool allows (capacity-aware water-filling apportionment: a stratum smaller than the current fair share is taken WHOLE and the shortfall is redistributed across the remaining strata; the final round splits any remainder one-each in ascending scenario-name order, since every remaining stratum's fair share is numerically identical at that point). Within a scenario, the utterances are drawn via random.Random(f'{seed}:{stage}:{scenario}').sample over the id-sorted eligible pool (mirrors reproduction.sampling.stratified_sample's own per-stratum seeding convention). One recording per selected utterance is resolved via random.Random(f'{seed}:{scenario}:{utterance_id}') over the utterance's id-sorted recordings, mirroring the historic probe-60 receipt's own selection_rule convention. DEV-500 and DEV-100 are drawn the SAME way but over DEV-1000's (respectively DEV-500's) own per-scenario selected utterance lists as the eligible pool, rather than the original devel pool, so each tier is an exact seeded SUBSET of the tier above it.
